name: Precise Attenuation
body:
Prerequisite(s): Dire Attenuation

Benefit(s): You can add two foes within 5′ of your dire zone to your dire zone. You need not exclude any foe from your dire zone in order to use this feat. This feat may be combined with Improved Attenuation. Changing your dire zone’s shape or area from its current shape or area is a move action.
